description: This is an initialization (__init__.py) file for the 'neuphonic' module within the 'pipecat.services' package. It imports the 'sys' module and the 'DeprecatedModuleProxy' class from 'pipecat.services', then reassigns the module to a proxy object for deprecation handling. It also imports all contents from the local 'tts' submodule.

classes.name: DeprecatedModuleProxy
classes.description: A proxy class used to mark a module as deprecated, providing warnings or alternative handling when the module is accessed.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the DeprecatedModuleProxy with the module's globals, the module name, and the new module path for deprecation handling.
